One system. Zero chasing.

Post, bid, award, deliver — the same sequence every time, whether it's one container or a fifty-truck contract lane.

01

Post the job

Equipment, terminal, delivery address, deadline, target price — one form, structured instantly. No back-and-forth to get a job in front of carriers.

02

Carriers bid

Verified carriers only — TRN, trade licence, and insurance checked before they ever see a load. Every bid is priced against the live Lane Index.

03

Award & escrow

Accept a bid and the price locks. Funds move into escrow automatically — no invoice to chase, no transfer to confirm by phone.

04

Deliver & release

POD goes up, escrow releases — confirm it yourself or let the 24-hour auto-release handle it. Either way, you're not calling anyone to get paid.
